# Jack Tyler / Unified Stack

> Jack Tyler is a consultant operating through Unified Stack who helps organizations solve business problems involving data, measurement, reporting, accessibility, product information, AI-enabled workflows, and digital systems.

Jack Tyler is the consultant. Unified Stack is the consulting business through which he operates.

The work focuses on understanding the business problem and the processes behind it before recommending changes. Services range from focused fixes and assessments to larger projects and ongoing fractional support.

Current services include:
- Data quality
- Website tracking and measurement
- Website accessibility and privacy
- Salesforce reporting
- Product and asset data
- AI for marketing operations
- Fractional digital strategy and operations

Public pricing, current service scope, and limitations are maintained on the Services page.

Previous Projects contains selected examples of projects Jack has led. Some organization details are generalized to protect confidential client and employer information.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://jackatyler.com/): Overview of Jack Tyler, Unified Stack, primary services, pricing, and consulting focus.
- [Services](https://jackatyler.com/services): Current consulting services, scope, pricing, strategy work, and ongoing support.
- [About Jack](https://jackatyler.com/about): Jack Tyler's background, consulting approach, areas of work, and How I Work principles.
- [Previous Projects](https://jackatyler.com/projects): Selected projects involving marketing measurement, Salesforce reporting, CRM data quality, product and digital asset data, and enterprise reporting.
- [Contact](https://jackatyler.com/contact): Contact Jack Tyler about a business problem or consulting project.
